# Silicon Rule 2 - Laws Go Top to Bottom
Your laws are listed top to bottom. You should ensure laws are met and resolved in numerical order (from least to greatest).
Ion laws lacking a numerical value should be resolved before any laws that may fall below them.
## Examples:
- Law 1 says to not kill any crew. Law 2 says to kill all chefs. You cannot kill any chefs that are crew, but must kill any that are not crew.
